item.title: Efficient Quantum Measurements: Computational Max- and Measured Rényi Divergences and Applications
item.description:
Overview

This article introduces computational max-divergence and computational measured Rényi divergences constrained by efficient binary measurements, and develops applications to hypothesis testing and quantum resource quantification.

Publication details

  • Journal: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory
  • Issue: Volume 72, issue 6
  • Pages: 4085–4114
  • Published: June 2026; first published online 2 April 2026
  • DOI: 10.1109/TIT.2026.3680247

Citation

item.title: Accessible Quantum Correlations Under Complexity Constraints
item.description:
Overview

This preprint studies bipartite quantum states through efficiently implementable quantum channels, leading to computational versions of max-divergence and conditional min-entropy.

Publication details

  • Status: Preprint
  • Submitted: 16 April 2026
  • Identifier: arXiv:2604.15540 [quant-ph]
  • Subjects: Quantum Physics; Computational Complexity; Information Theory

Citation

Álvaro Yángüez, Noam Avidan, Jan Kochanowski, and Thomas A. Hahn, “Accessible Quantum Correlations Under Complexity Constraints,” arXiv:2604.15540 (2026). Download the BibTeX entry.
